We need to generate new test cases for createExecutionContext, covering untested combos. Existing tests cover:

- custom ExecutionContext supplier (non-null)
- default supplier with flags: (true,false), (false,false), (true,true). Actually they have three cases: true,false; false,false; true,true. They didn't cover false,true (items false, properties true). Also maybe null config? Or config with both flags default? Also test when validationContext.getConfig() returns null? But code uses config = validationContext.getConfig(); If config null, NullPointerException. Could test that scenario? But maybe not expected. Could test when config.getExecutionContextSupplier() returns a supplier that throws exception? Or returns null? If supplier returns null, method returns null. Could test that.

Also test that ExecutionContext is created with CollectorContext having correct flags when config has default values (maybe default is false). Already covered false,false.

Edge: config.isUnevaluatedItemsAnalysisDisabled() may throw? Not.

Also test that the ExecutionContext returned is a new instance each call (when no supplier). So two calls produce different objects.

Also test that ExecutionContext's collectorContext is not null.

Thus we need to produce new test cases not duplicate.

We'll propose groups:

- createExecutionContext – default supplier with mixed flags (false,true)
- createExecutionContext – supplier returns null
- createExecutionContext – supplier throws RuntimeException (ensure exception propagates)
- createExecutionContext – multiple invocations produce distinct ExecutionContext instances
- createExecutionContext – validationContext returns null config (expect NullPointerException)

But maybe the class expects config never null; but we can still test NullPointerException.

We'll output JSON array with groups.

Make sure format matches: each case input list of parameter objects (no parameters, so empty list). expected string description.

We'll produce groups accordingly.
